raw: | A `describe → exec` round trip on a page whose object-list item carries a **text template with a placeholder** turns a building page into **CE0720** "Place holder index 1 is greater than 0, the number of parameter(s)". The DESCRIBE text is identical before and after | Two bugs, one on each side. DESCRIBE emitted the template's TEXT and discarded its parameters — `extractTextTemplateText` already returns the template map and `extractObjectListItem` threw it away. And the engine read the companion with a **case-sensitive map index**, `child.Properties[matchedAlias+"Params"]`, where `matchedAlias` is the SCHEMA key (`buttonCaption`) while the script and DESCRIBE write the widget's own casing (`ButtonCaptionParams`) | `mdl/executor/cmd_pages_describe_objectlist.go` (emit `<Key>Params`), `mdl/executor/widget_engine.go` (`lookupProperty` for the companion), `mdl/grammar/domains/MDLPage.g4` + `mdl/visitor/visitor_page_v3.go` (a generic `<Name>Params` form); tests `mdl/executor/widget_item_template_params_test.go` | **Fix both sides or neither shows**: emitting the params without the lookup fix still drops them, and the lookup fix alone has nothing to read — each half has its own control. **The grammar had no generic form**: only `ContentParams`/`CaptionParams` have tokens, so emitting `ButtonCaptionParams` first requires `(IDENTIFIER | keyword) COLON paramListV3`, placed BEFORE the generic `propertyValueV3` alternatives — which also admit `[...]`, and `{N} = expr` inside is what separates them. Render through `formatParametersV3`: `extractClientTemplateParameters` returns bare expressions and `paramListV3` needs `{N} = expr`, so a raw join produces `['abc']`, which parses as an ARRAY and silently sets the wrong thing. **The case-sensitivity agreed by luck for a DataGrid column** (`Caption` → `CaptionParams` matches what MDL writes), which is why the defect survived — any test using a column passes. Issue #956 |
